item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-29
item.description:
It's been an exciting week in our open-source research community, with notable progress made in two key projects. The scienceverse/metacheck project saw significant enhancements to its data checking functionality, with Lakens adding "stat output" and making iterative improvements to the "data_check" branch. Meanwhile, the marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing project received updates to both its website and alert functionality, with a new site build for version 0.4.1 and a refinement to the success alert title in the `sweet_alert.js` file. These developments demonstrate the community's commitment to improving research tools and highlight the connections between projects, such as the potential for metacheck's enhanced data checking to inform tenzing's alert functionality. As our projects continue to evolve, we celebrate the collaborative spirit and technical expertise that drive our community forward. With these updates, we're one step closer to creating a more robust and integrated research ecosystem.
